title: What to Preserve, Where to Adapt: A Depth-Wise Analysis of Forgetting in Continual Gynecological Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2608.13660v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Medical image segmentation models are typically trained under the assumption that all data are available simultaneously. However, in clinical practice, datasets often arrive sequentially, requiring models to adapt continuously to evolving data distributions. We study this problem in gynecological image segmentation, where substantial heterogeneity across imaging modalities, anatomical structures, and annotation protocols creates a particularly challenging continual learning setting. Under these large distribution shifts, existing continual learning methods struggle to preserve previously learned knowledge, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To better understand forgetting in this setting, we investigate how different encoder--decoder regions influence segmentation performance and forgetting during continual gynecological segmentation. translated_title: 保留什么，适应哪里：持续妇科图像分割中遗忘的深度分析
translated_abstract: 医学图像分割模型通常在假设所有数据同时可用的条件下进行训练。然而，在临床实践中，数据集常常顺序到达，要求模型持续适应不断变化的数据分布。我们在妇科图像分割中研究这一问题，其中成像模态、解剖结构和标注协议之间的显著异质性构成了一个特别具有挑战性的持续学习场景。在这些大的分布偏移下，现有的持续学习方法难以保留先前学到的知识，导致灾难性遗忘。为了更好地理解这种场景下的遗忘，我们研究了不同的编码器-解码器区域如何影响持续妇科分割中的分割性能和遗忘。通过分块消融分析，我们观察到消融早期编码器和晚期解码器区域会产生特定影响。
tldr: 本文通过深度分析揭示，在持续妇科图像分割中，早期编码器和晚期解码器区域对遗忘影响最大，为设计更有效的保留策略提供了针对性指导。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals through depth-wise analysis that early encoder and late decoder regions most significantly influence forgetting in continual gynecological segmentation, providing targeted guidance for designing more effective preservation strategies.
